# Rise and Battle the Day
## Scripture
"Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be frightened, and do not be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." – Joshua 1:9
## Reflection
Every morning you wake up, a battle is already waiting. Not against flesh and blood, but against complacency, distraction, and the quiet pull to settle for an easy life. Joshua faced the same tension. He stood at the edge of the Promised Land with giants ahead and a nation behind him, and God didn't offer him a comfortable escape—He gave him a command: be strong and courageous.

Notice the foundation of that command. It wasn't Joshua's own grit or talent. It was the presence of God: "the LORD your God is with you wherever you go." Courage isn't the absence of fear; it's obedience in the presence of fear because you know who stands with you.

Too many men drift through their days reacting instead of rising. They wait to feel ready, wait for motivation, wait for the perfect moment. But strength is built in the choosing—deciding each morning to show up, to lead, to fight for what matters. You don't wait for courage to find you. You step into the day believing God is already there.
## Daily Challenge
Before your feet hit the floor tomorrow, say Joshua 1:9 out loud. Then do 20 pushups—one for each year of Joshua's generation that had to learn to trust God. Rise and battle the day.
